bug_report:
Add __attribute__ ((target("80387"))) support
There is no way to turn on/off 80387 support with attribute:

[hjl@gnu-zen4-1 x86-2]$ cat x.c
__attribute__ ((target("no-mmx,no-80387")))
void
func1 (void)
{
}

__attribute__ ((target("mmx,80387")))
void
func2 (void)
{
}
[hjl@gnu-zen4-1 x86-2]$ make CC=gcc
gcc -O2 -S x.c
x.c:3:1: error: attribute ‘target’ argument ‘no-80387’ is unknown
    3 | func1 (void)
      | ^~~~~
x.c:9:1: error: attribute ‘target’ argument ‘80387’ is unknown
    9 | func2 (void)
      | ^~~~~
make: *** [Makefile:31: x.s] Error 1
[hjl@gnu-zen4-1 x86-2]$
